outcome: Quality of childbirth care (during admission, intrapartum, and immediate postpartum period)
cohort: The study included 865 women who delivered in public health facilities in Gondar, Ethiopia.
finding: The proportion of good-quality childbirth care varied across the continuum (59% at admission, 76.8% intrapartum, and 45% immediate postpartum), and was predicted by various maternal, provider, and facility factors.
